context.problem: We possess granular AI cost and usage metrics in the database, but no internal UI to visualize business health (MRR, Total Cost, User Activity). Without a proper Admin dashboard, evaluating the profitability of the SaaS requires manual SQL querying.

wave.label: Admin Role Schema
wave.task: Create migration adding `is_admin BOOLEAN DEFAULT false` to `public.users`.
Create a new `@require_admin` decorator that extends `@require_auth` to verify `g.current_user["is_admin"]` is True.
Update login/signup/me routes to include the `is_admin` flag in the returned user object. Update `user_schema.py` if necessary over the API interface.

wave.label: Admin Metrics Endpoints
wave.task: Create a new Blueprint for admin endpoints. Guarded by `@require_admin`. Route `GET /api/v1/admin/stats`: - Calculate Total Users, Total MRR (estimated off plans), Total API Cost, Total Replies. Route `GET /api/v1/admin/users`: - Paginated list of all users, their plan, their used quota, and cost generated.

wave.label: React Admin Dashboard
wave.task: Create a strictly gated Admin page fetching the new endpoints. Design a 4-card metric layout (Users, Total MRR, AI Cost, Margin %) and a table for user management.
Conditionally render an "Admin Panel" sidebar link only if `user?.is_admin` is true.
Register the `<Route path="/admin" element={} />` under the Protected Route structure.
